applicabilityBasis.summary: NECT is minted against collateral deposited in Beraborrow Dens and is redeemed through the protocol for collateral at face value minus a dynamic fee, with redemptions liquidating the least collateralized borrower positions. Public documentation and the site legal page identify no legal issuer obligated to pay holders a fixed amount of US currency or bank-deposit monetary value, so GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability stays unclear despite dollar-pegged payment marketing.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-28. No legal issuer of NECT is identified. The legal page names Base Zero Labs Ltd only as the owner of brand and intellectual property, applies British Virgin Islands law, and geo-blocks the application for US and UK persons; it names no EEA restriction and no token issuer. No issuerEntity is recorded because no exact legal entity is evidenced. Redemption returns collateral at face value, not currency or bank-deposit monetary value. The US and UK application geo-block is an interface access restriction, not a token-level exclusion.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-28, the Federal Register search, official issuer domains and token-specific web searches found no GENIUS permitted payment stablecoin issuer approval, state qualification, official application or foreign-issuer registration for Beraborrow or NECT. The token has no identified legal issuer to hold such a status. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no unpublished filing exists.
